run_TreeLoss_forward: run the TreeLoss forward pass on a list of parse tree nodes to compute loss and accuracy
create_LabelSmoothingBCE: create a LabelSmoothingBCE loss module with configurable smoothing for binary cross entropy
create_LabelSmoothingCE: create a LabelSmoothingCE loss module with configurable smoothing for cross entropy classification
run_epoch_training: run a training or evaluation epoch over a data loader with the model and loss function
compute_precision_recall: compute macro and micro precision, recall, and F1 stats for tree prediction across examples
